ValidationRule.description: This rule will restrict all users which don't have the custom permission 'Unit Editor' from updating the Unit Name, Plot No, Unit Classification and Number of Bedrooms fields on Unit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Source_Entity__c , "Modon - Egypt"), NOT( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT($Permission.Unit_Editor_Egypt) , OR( ISCHANGED( Name ) , ISCHANGED( PlotNo__c ) , ISCHANGED( UnitClassification__c ), ISCHANGED( Number_of_Bedrooms__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to edit unit records.
